annotations.note: Q326 real rev TRY 82.0bn (+6.2%), EBITDA TRY 36.24bn (+6.8%, 44.2% margin); net debt TRY 40.7bn (0.31x) post-5G outlays.
Long-term master lease agreements (10-15 year tenors) with Tier-1 telecom operators featuring contractual annual inflation escalators and power cost pass-through.
Expanding tenancy ratio (1.6x - 2.1x) yields substantial operating leverage, driving rapid organic deleveraging with minimal incremental capex.
Contracted multi-year revenue backlog exceeding 6-8x annual revenues guarantees high earnings visibility and predictable debt service capacity.
Real revenue +6.2% YoY in Q3 (TRY 82.04bn) and EBITDA +6.8% YoY (TRY 36.24bn, 44.2% margin); net leverage 0.31x.

verdict.summary: Turkcell posted 6.2% real Q326 revenue growth (TRY 82.0bn) and 44.2% EBITDA margin (TRY 36.24bn), keeping net leverage ultra-low at 0.31x (TRY 40.7bn net debt) even after absorbing major 5G spectrum/license outlays.

positives: Ultra-low 0.31x net leverage at 3Q26, well below management's 1.0x ceiling even after strategic capex.
Strong pricing power & margin expansion: Q3 EBITDA margin up +30bp YoY to 44.2% (real +6.8% EBITDA growth).
High-growth Techfin (Paycell/Financell) and data center diversification.
negatives: 5G spectrum auction & HQ/infrastructure outlays could nudge leverage modestly higher in 2027.
Turkish sovereign/FX ceiling (BB/BB-) limits rating upside.
Macro inflation sensitivity on ARPUs despite real price pass-through.
